technical: Due materialization, atomic claim, bounded lease (30s-15m), monotonic fencing epoch, safe expiry reclaim (SQLite 9).
settle_job_run does not require (run_id, owner_token, fencing_epoch), so a stale owner can settle a reclaimed generation.
A valid lease is coordination, never execution authority: no dispatcher, worker loop, approval or connector path exists yet.
